newsitem.title: USA: Wash. nuclear plant to restart June 23 for testing.
newsitem.headline: Wash. nuclear plant to restart June 23 for testing.

text.p: The 1,112 megawatt (MW) WNP-2 nuclear power plant in Washington state will resume operations June 23 so testing can be completed in time for the post-July 4 market, a spokeswoman for the Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) said Wednesday.
The unit has been shut since late March at the request of BPA, which sells the nuclear plant's power output.
At that time, BPA said it probably would not need the nuclear generation before early July since suppiles of lower-cost hydropower were expected to be abundant this spring.
The plant is expected to achieve full power June 27, after which it will ramp down to partial capacity so that systems testing which began in March can be completed, the BPA spokeswoman said.
"We still don't expect to need the power until after July 4, when streamflows start to decline," she noted.
